description: Non-material amendment to planning permission ref. 16147/APP/2024/2912, dated 21-01-2025 (Erection of two storey rear extension, and conversion of roof space into habitable use to include a rear dormer and 2no. side facing roof lights. Rendering of external walls.) to install 2 x windows to the front elevation
decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted shall not be carried out except in complete accordance with the details shown on the submitted plans numbered
and shall thereafter be retained/maintained for as long as the development remains in existence.
To ensure the development complies with the provisions of the Hillingdon Local Plan Part 1 (2012), Part 2 (2020) and the London Plan (2021).

Notwithstanding the non-material amendment hereby approved, other than condition 2 which is superseded by the above condition,  all other conditions relating to Planning Permission Ref: 16147/APP/2024/2912, dated  21-01-25 must be discharged/adhered to as per that permission.
